overview: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle is a 2017 American action-adventure film directed by Jake Kasdan and written by Chris McKenna, Erik Sommers, Scott Rosenberg, and Jeff Pinkner. The film is the third installment in the Jumanji film series, a sequel to Jumanji (1995) and its spin-off film Zathura: A Space Adventure (2005). It stars Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart, and Karen Gillan, with Nick Jonas, Rhys Darby, and Bobby Cannavale in supporting roles.
